scope: Different-author, read-only audit of the consumed M1808 C3 mapped-energy production attempt, its attempt latch, sealed ordinary failure, preserved preflight-governance quarantine, and unsealed private build. The audit started no VCS, simulation, SAIF, PTPX, DC, Formality, GPU, remote, license, commit, or push operation and mutated no predecessor evidence.
verdict: The M1808 production result is correctly FAIL_CLOSED and is not a token-only failure. One mapped VCS compile succeeded and the sole mapped simulation reached the third quiescent post-reset edge, then the testbench fired at line 287 and 31.7 ns because at least one of the eleven public debug counters still contained X/Z. The fatal occurs before configuration, warmup, the numerical scoreboard workload, or the SAIF measurement window. Consequently zero runtime PASS tokens are a downstream symptom, not the root cause. No arithmetic mismatch is established because functional traffic never began. No SAIF or PTPX run exists, the canonical result is absent, and the private build remains unsealed/do-not-cite. The unique attempt is consumed with automatic_retry=false and must not be relaunched. Existing C3 M1456 timing/area evidence is not invalidated, but M1808 contributes no mapped functional, power, or energy admission.

classification.reason_for_counter_identity_limit: The M1808 boundary check aggregates all eleven counters in one $isunknown expression and prints no per-counter values. M1806 previously localized first-cycle X/Z to six counters, but M1808 alone does not prove which subset remains unknown at the third edge.

findings.finding: The exact three-cycle reset-settling repair did not close: at least one public debug counter remains X/Z at the boundary, before configuration or numeric traffic.
findings.impact: M1808 cannot admit mapped functionality, SAIF, component power, or component energy. Treating the missing PASS token as a parser-only problem would hide a real gate-level initialization failure.
findings.minimal_fix: Do not retry or modify the consumed M1808 namespace. Any future recovery must use a new additive production namespace and must first add a read-only per-counter boundary diagnostic or repair the mapped reset/initialization cause, then undergo fresh different-author source review and an exact release. Existing M1456 area/timing remains the C3 physical evidence meanwhile.
